stem.text: Two train carriages each of mass $5000\,\text{kg}$ roll toward one another on a horizontal frictionless track. One is travelling at a speed of $2.00\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and the other at a speed of $1.00\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Two train carriages on a horizontal track, each labelled 5000 kg. Above the left carriage is an arrow pointing right labelled 2.00 m s-1; above the right carriage is an arrow pointing left labelled 1.00 m s-1.

stem.text: What is the kinetic energy lost during the collision?
